definitions.full: H8167. Seirah II. [ שְׂעִירָה ] proper name, of a location , probably in southeast Ephraim (= goat , Thes); — with ה locative הַשְּׂעִי֫רָתָה Judg 3:26 ; Σε ( Τ ) ειρωθα , ᵐ5 L Σηρωθα .
